description: This file contains the implementation of the SecondMoment class, which computes the second central moment (sum of squared deviations from the mean) within the Apache Commons Math library. It extends FirstMoment and provides methods for updating the moment, copying instances, and retrieving the result.

classes.name: SecondMoment
classes.description: Implements calculation of the second central moment (variance-like measure) by extending FirstMoment, enabling incremental updates of the second moment value.

methods.name: SecondMoment
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the second moment calculation.

methods.name: SecondMoment
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new SecondMoment object by copying an existing one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Updates the second moment with a new data point, implementing the recursive formula for the second central moment.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the second moment calculation.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the second moment.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the SecondMoment instance.

methods.name: copy (static method)
methods.description: Copies data from a source SecondMoment object to a destination SecondMoment object.
